profile.name: Handis Pramudio Ananta
profile.bio: Informatics Engineering student passionate about building scalable web applications and solving real-world problems through code.

paragraphs: Informatics Engineering student at Universitas Dian Nuswantoro (UDINUS) with a strong interest in Software Engineering, Web Development, and Information Systems.
Experienced in developing web-based applications, including inventory management systems, portfolio websites, and business management solutions using Laravel, PHP, JavaScript, and MySQL.

Familiar with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), database design, REST API integration, and responsive web development. Passionate about building scalable and user-friendly applications while continuously improving technical skills through hands-on projects and professional certifications.

projects.title: Inventory Management System
projects.summary: A web-based CRUD inventory system with relational database design, form validation, and seamless frontend-backend integration using Laravel.

details.label: The Problem
details.text: Stock was tracked in spreadsheets, making item counts error-prone and movement history hard to audit.

details.label: What I Built
details.text: A Laravel application with a relational MySQL schema, server-side form validation, searchable item records, and an admin dashboard for incoming and outgoing stock.

details.label: Result
details.text: Stock movement now lives in one place, with low-stock highlights and a clean CRUD flow that is easy for non-technical staff to follow.

projects.title: Coffeeflow — Coffee Shop Website
projects.summary: A responsive coffee shop management website with product catalog, menu management, and user-friendly navigation across all devices.

details.label: The Problem
details.text: Menu changes and product information were handled manually, so the shop needed a site that staff could update quickly.

details.label: What I Built
details.text: A mobile-first site with a structured product catalog, a menu section that is easy to extend, and navigation tested across phone, tablet, and desktop.

details.label: Result
details.text: A consistent browsing experience on every screen size, with a catalog layout that makes adding new menu items straightforward.

projects.title: CoffeeBoss — Supplier Kopi Temanggung
projects.summary: A company profile for CoffeeBoss Indonesia — a supplier and exporter of Arabica and Robusta green coffee beans from the highlands of Temanggung, built with a dark-luxury direction.

details.label: The Problem
details.text: A premium Indonesian coffee supplier needed a credible, global-facing presence that matched the quality of its beans.

details.label: What I Built
details.text: A dark-luxury company profile with a product showcase, origin story, and a clear inquiry path for wholesale buyers.

details.label: Result
details.text: A sharper brand impression and a single destination that explains origin, product grades, and how to start an order.
